people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
translations.bsb: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translations.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
translations.asv: I protest by that glorifying in you, brethren, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
